name: Add Comment To Issue
description: Adds a new comment to an issue. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issue-comments/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-comment-post)

configurable_props.name: issueIdOrKey
configurable_props.label: Issue ID or Key
configurable_props.description: The ID or key of an issue

configurable_props.name: body
configurable_props.label: Body
configurable_props.description: The comment text in [Atlassian Document Format](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/apis/document/structure/), e.g. `{"type":"doc","version":1,"content":[{"content":[{"text":"This is a comment","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"}]}`. Will overwrite comment if both comment and body are provided

configurable_props.name: visibility
configurable_props.label: Visibility
configurable_props.description: The group or role to which this comment is visible, See `Visibility` section of [doc](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issue-comments/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-comment-post)

configurable_props.name: additionalProperties
configurable_props.label: Additional properties
configurable_props.description: Extra properties of any type may be provided to this object

configurable_props.name: expand
configurable_props.label: Expand
configurable_props.description: The Jira REST API uses resource expansion, which means that some parts of a resource are not returned unless specified in the request. This parameter accepts `renderedBody`, which returns the comment body rendered in HTML.
